about_the_game:
Meow Factories Inc.
Automate. Assemble. Deliver cats.
Build an adorably chaotic factory where you bring kittens to life!

Meow¡ Factories Inc. is a colorful automation game with surreal humor, where your goal is to optimize cat production using charming resources and an increasingly complex assembly line.

Starting from a modest manual setup, you’ll expand your factory by unlocking specialized “meowchines,” assemblers, transport systems, and painting machines, all to meet the growing demand for cats of every color, shape, and style.

Create and deliver full cats to progress and unlock new technologies!

  • Deliver cats and fulfill special orders to level up.

  • Each level unlocks new machines, upgrades, and logistical challenges.

  • Optimize efficiency to reach full automation.

If you love automation games and always dreamed of a factory full of cats, Meow Factories Inc. is the place for you!

short_description: Automate. Assemble. Deliver cats. Build an adorable factory, create cats piece by piece, and optimize your production to meet an ever-growing demand. Unlock machines, paint your cats, and make your feline assembly line run like clockwork!
